big_picture.title: Nasdaq Hit Amid Tariff, AI Spending Fears; What To Do During The Market Rally Attempt
big_picture.excerpt: The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite sold off Tuesday amid new tariffs threats and more AI spending fears. Here's what to do in the rally attempt.
paragraphs: The stock market finished sharply mixed Tuesday as Wall Street reacted to a report that the Trump administration is preparing another round of tariffs on China and dozens of other countries. Meanwhile, renewed fears about a slowdown in spending on data centers for artificial intelligence heavily pressured technology stocks.
